summary: 8/8 acceptance criteria exercised with 1 backend test file + 1 browser check each (13 backend tests across the 6 API-bearing criteria + 8 browser checks). All artifacts passed on first or second run.

checks.criterion: Super Admin can log in and only SUPER_ADMIN can access /admin
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_login_and_role_gate.py
checks.evidence: GET /admin/summary with SUPER_ADMIN token -> 200 {total_restaurants, mrr,...}; GET /admin/summary with owner token -> 403 'Super Admin access required'

checks.criterion: Super Admin can log in and only SUPER_ADMIN can access /admin
checks.name: admin-login-and-role-gate
checks.evidence: admin@restaurantai.pk login -> redirected to /admin, admin-dashboard visible with stat tiles; owner@pizzapalace.pk login -> /dashboard, direct nav to /admin redirected away (not /admin)

checks.criterion: Super Admin can create a restaurant with generated one-time credentials
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_create_restaurant.py
checks.evidence: POST /admin/restaurants -> 200 {credentials:{username,password,login_url}}; new id present in GET /admin/restaurants; generated creds successfully POST /auth/login -> 200

checks.criterion: Super Admin can create a restaurant with generated one-time credentials
checks.name: admin-create-restaurant-shows-credentials
checks.evidence: Add Restaurant form submit shows created-credentials block with username/password once; new row tscheck-browser-<ts> appears in Restaurants table

checks.name: test_tscheck_manual_subscription_management.py
checks.evidence: GET /admin/subscriptions shows status/end_date/monthly_price; POST /admin/reminders -> 200 {type:SUBSCRIPTION_REMINDER,status:CREATED}; POST /admin/restaurants/{id}/payment on a SUSPENDED sub -> 200 {status:ACTIVE,payment_status:PAID,end_date>before}
checks.notes: 3 tests in this file, all passed

checks.name: subscriptions-reminder-and-payment
checks.evidence: Created tscheck-sub-<ts> restaurant; clicked Send Reminder -> POST /api/admin/reminders 200; clicked Payment Received -> POST /api/admin/restaurants/{id}/payment 200 body {status:ACTIVE,payment_status:PAID}

checks.criterion: Restaurant subscription gate preserves billing access
checks.name: test_tscheck_subscription_gate_preserves_billing.py
checks.evidence: ACTIVE tenant: GET /billing -> 200 ACTIVE, GET /orders -> 200. After admin PATCH status=SUSPENDED: GET /orders -> 402 {code:SUBSCRIPTION_BLOCKED}; GET /billing -> 200 (still accessible) with status SUSPENDED

checks.criterion: Restaurant subscription gate preserves billing access
checks.name: subscription-gate-blocks-suspended-tenant
checks.evidence: Created tscheck-gate-<ts>, suspended via admin toggle (200), logged in as that tenant -> app router redirected to /billing (not /dashboard) and billing page rendered; console showed expected 402s from other protected APIs the frontend still probes

checks.criterion: Restaurant tenant isolation and existing dashboard remain functional
checks.name: test_tscheck_tenant_isolation.py
checks.evidence: owner@pizzapalace.pk: GET /auth/me, /orders, /menu, /customers all 200 and orders scoped to own restaurant_id; GET /admin/restaurants -> 403

checks.criterion: Restaurant tenant isolation and existing dashboard remain functional
checks.name: restaurant-dashboard-tenant-isolation
checks.evidence: owner login shows dashboard-shell with restaurant-name 'Pizza Palace'; Orders/Menu/Customers nav all render; direct nav to /admin does not reach admin shell

checks.criterion: Dark mode works across both panels
checks.name: dark-mode-persists-across-panels
checks.evidence: Toggled dark mode in restaurant dashboard, html gains 'dark' class, persists across reload; admin panel (after login) also shows 'dark' class from persisted preference; both shells rendered without visual break; toggled back off

checks.criterion: Google Sheets configuration architecture is available
checks.name: google-sheets-config-saves-masked
checks.evidence: PUT /api/google-sheets/config -> 200, response echoes spreadsheet_id and returns google_client_secret_masked (never plaintext secret); page states 'Live OAuth sync activates after credentials are provided'

checks.criterion: Super Admin settings and credential changes are protected
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_settings_and_credentials_protected.py
checks.evidence: PUT /admin/settings monthly_price editable (200, value persisted then restored); PUT /admin/profile with wrong current_password -> 400; correct current_password rotates password (200), audit-logs contains action UPDATED_ADMIN_PROFILE; original credentials restored at end of test

checks.criterion: Super Admin settings and credential changes are protected
checks.name: admin-settings-price-and-credentials-protected
checks.evidence: Platform monthly price editable via blur -> PUT 200 persisted then restored; reminder template field present; wrong current password -> PUT /api/admin/profile 400; correct password rotates (200) and shows 'Admin credentials updated.'; original password restored via fresh login
